meta_description: Press resources for Silver & Elegant — brand summary, founder biography, and editorial assets.
brand_summary_body:
SILVER & ELEGANT is an independent London jewellery house, founded in January 2025. Every piece is shaped through architectural design and finished by hand by a master artisan in Istanbul's historic Kapalıçarşı district. The brand creates Future Heirlooms — sculptural pieces crafted for permanence, not seasons.

Silver & Elegant has been featured in KALTBLUT Magazine, Flanelle Magazine, the Borehamwood Times, and the Wolf & Badger Jewellery Guide, and served as an official jewellery partner for the Paul Costelloe AW26 show. The brand holds Black Sheep status on Not Just A Label, and its founder is a Fellow of the Royal Society of Arts (FRSA).
founder_bio_body:
Esen Tunalı Sarı, FRSA, is the founder and creative director of SILVER & ELEGANT.

Born in Ruse, Bulgaria, and raised in Istanbul's historic Bakırköy district adjacent to Kapalıçarşı, her design practice bridges architectural heritage with contemporary sculptural precision. She founded SILVER & ELEGANT in Borehamwood, Hertfordshire, in 2025.
